rows.en:
(Maybe I'll buckle down and actually
study today.)
Oh, who's that studying over there...
Heeey, Shirakawa~
Ah...
You're studying too, Shirakawa?
Shh!

Please be quiet.
Everyone here is trying to study...
Oh, sorry, sorry...
Are you here to study too?
Yeah, I've been goofing off way too much lately.

Still, I think it's admirable that you came
to study of your own accord.

Now, a long chat will bother everyone
around us, so let's study.

Hey, hey, Shirakawa.
About this part here...
Umm, Shirakawa-saaan?
rows.notes: Male; the Japanese adds -san (drawn out) for comic effect.

rows.en:
Sigh~, she's totally focused...
Oh well, guess I'll tough it out on my own...

I'm so tired today.
The exam covers way too much...

If you studied regularly,
this wouldn't happen, you know.
I have nothing to say in my defense...
rows.notes: Male (formal kaesu kotoba mo gozaimasen, mock-humble).

rows.en:
What do you wanna do after this?
Wanna go get something to eat?
Yes, let's go.
Is there anywhere you want to go?

No, not particularly...
Well, let me see, um...

Oh, that thing from the other day...
The bread with the stuffed meat in it...
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki, groping for the word; nikuzume = stuffed meat (a sausage).

rows.en: Stuffed meat...... You mean a hot dog?
Yes, I'd like to have one of those again.

So you got hooked, Shirakawa~
On how tasty they are.
Maybe I did!
Then let's go!

(Shirakawa seems like a proper young lady,
but she's just a normal girl after all.)
(Maybe I'll actually study seriously today~)
Heeey, Miyuki~
Are you studying too, Miyuki?
Ahaha, sorry, sorry...
Yeah, I've been goofing off way too much lately.
Yeah, time to buckle down!

Hey, hey, Miyuki...
About this part here...
Umm, Miyuki-saaan?

Sigh~, she's totally focused...
Oh well, I'll just do my best on my own...
Ahahaha...

What do you wanna do after this?
Wanna go get something to eat?
Is there anywhere you want to go, Miyuki?

So you got hooked too, Miyuki~
On how tasty they are.

(Miyuki seems like a proper young lady,
but she's just a normal girl after all.)

(Studying in the library always seems
to go so much better~)

Studying hard, are we,
\p-kun?

Hey, Shirakawa.
Not exactly hard, but I'm doing homework...
What brings you here, Shirakawa?
I came to borrow a book.

...Hey, if you don't mind,
could you help me study?
rows.notes: x2, player asking Miyuki to teach them.

rows.en: Me?

Please, I'm begging you!
I'll never ask for anything again!
Sigh... Just for today, all right?

You really saved me, Shirakawa.
That was super easy to understand.
So it's not just sports you're good at, huh.
I-I'm going home now!

(She left...
And I was going to treat her to a meal
as thanks.)

Studying hard, are we,
\p-san?

Hi, Miyuki~
I was just doing my homework.
What brings you to the library, Miyuki?

Miyuki, you really saved me~
That was super easy to understand.
So it's not just sports you're good at, huh.

(She left...
And I was going to treat her to a meal
as thanks.)
